scheme_name: HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth

key_metrics.exit_load: 1% if redeemed within 1 year (365 days); Nil after 1 year

parsed_sections.Investment Objective: To provide long-term capital appreciation by investing predominantly in equity and equity-related instruments of mid-cap companies (companies ranked 101st to 250th by market capitalization).
parsed_sections.Expense Ratio & Exit Load: Expense ratio is 0.76% (Direct Plan). Exit load is 1% if redeemed within 1 year (365 days); Nil if redeemed after 1 year.
parsed_sections.Minimum Investment & Liquidity: Minimum SIP investment is ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum investment is ₹100. No lock-in period. Open for subscription and redemption on all business days.
parsed_sections.Riskometer & Benchmark: Riskometer classification is Very High. Benchmark index is NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index (TRI).
